versions.changelog:
**English documentation rewrite and version bump.**

- Fully rewrote documentation and usage instructions in English.
- Retained all platform-specific workflow details, technical notes, and troubleshooting guides, now in concise English.
- No code or functional changes; this update only affects documentation.
- Version bumped to 1.3.0 to reflect the rewritten, improved guidance.

No file changes detected in this release.

- No user-facing features or internal code updates.
- No documentation or metadata modifications.
- Version and skill documentation remain unchanged.

**Added DealRoadShow support and unified platform workflow.**

- Added support for DealRoadShow by introducing `scripts/dealroadshow-capture.py`.
- Introduced a unified entry script (`scripts/roadshow-capture.py`) that auto-routes based on URL, handling both NetRoadShow and DealRoadShow platforms.
- Updated documentation to reflect dual-platform support, workflow specifics, and technical caveats for each provider.
- No breaking changes; NetRoadShow automation remains fully supported and unchanged.
- Environment variable/email configuration unified for both platforms.

Initial release of "roadshow-capture" – automated NetRoadShow/online roadshow slide capture to PDF using Playwright.

- Automates login, authentication, and navigation for NetRoadShow platforms, bypassing Camofox limitations.
- Uses Playwright (Chromium headless) for RPA: fills email, handles JS-only buttons, and navigates slide decks.
- Captures screenshots for each slide and merges them into a single PDF via Pillow.
- First-run guided setup: collects user email and stores it in a local .env file—no manual env config needed.
- Handles popups and unusual UI elements with robust programmatic interaction techniques.
- Supports only "Start from beginning" mode to ensure full slide capture every time.
